studies.title: The kamal
studies.caption: A wooden card on a knotted string: held at arm's length against the Pole Star, the knot shows the ship's latitude.
studies.prompt: Side profile close view of an Indian Ocean navigator near Julfar about1400CE holding a small rectangular wooden board at arms length on a cord from his mouth, aligning its bottom with the sea horizon and top with the low Pole Star; knots on cord visible. No sextant or telescope.
